name: Ulan Caernach
found: Hearth-Hall in the evenings, with the older fighters.
appearance: 22, lean, deliberate, a carved curved knife at his belt.
and_yet: Rubs the knife's grip with his thumb when thinking.
wants: To understand what he has become.
oddly_also: Wants someone to tell him whether the alliance with the dead is right. Suspects no one will.
family: Mother Rinna; brother Theren, who wants to join the Elunad; stepfather Mellan, a hunter, who gave him the knife.
anecdotes: He won the trial by combat against Tenn Darnel at the Circle of Cossus.
He fought orcs and animated skeletons alongside the party.
campaign_notes: Sardet officiated his duel and has his respect. Will answer the party's call without much persuasion.
